section_summary.extract_value: This LIMITATION section describes the constraints of a cross-sectional study examining body appreciation (BA), weight loss (WL), and body dissatisfaction in a convenience sample of women with good health and moderate to higher socioeconomic status. The authors acknowledge limitations in generalizability and note that other variables such as social media affect, self-compassion, and body acceptance by others were not examined.
